messages:
infra-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'bluepeak-prod' node gpu-07 reporting GPU ECC and thermal errors. Repeated healthcheck failures over last 2m. Paging oncall (pager duty).

alex_sre: got the page, looking. any customer impact visible? :eyes:

ben_platform: yes — BluePeak tenant traffic shows elevated 5xx (mainly 503s) on model-route /generate (p95 latency spikes). Only the dedicated pool is affected.

alex_sre: ok. first step: isolate node and start drain. lina, can you confirm whether gpu-07 is a spot/preemptible VM or reserved hardware? I want to know if this is eviction vs hardware fault.

lina_infra: checking cloud console now — gpu-07 was booted from an on-demand reserved instance for this pool. Not a spot. Logs show repeated ECC corrections then a final fatal GPU error (see snippet). This looks like hardware failure, not spot eviction.

ben_platform: logs:
```
[2026-03-15T02:45:12Z] gpu0 ECC_CORRECTABLE count increase
[2026-03-15T02:46:01Z] nvml: NVML_ERROR_GPU_IS_LOST
[2026-03-15T02:46:02Z] kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 79, GPU fault
```

alex_sre: thanks. Plan: 1) drain gpu-07 from the pool 2) migrate active sessions (evict/redirect) for BluePeak 3) place node into maintenance and start replacement/RAID memcheck 4) failover policy for customer to routed-hosted fallback if capacity drops. I'll execute drain now.

alex_sre: running drain command:
```
rdctl pool drain --pool bluepeak-prod --node gpu-07 --grace-period 60s --force-evict
```

deploy-bot: rdctl: eviction started for node gpu-07. 12 sessions to migrate.

ben_platform: starting session migration. We have sticky KV caches for many requests; for long-running chat sessions we need to rehydrate. I'll trigger cache snapshot export for active sessions for BluePeak.

lina_infra: while that's running, I put a hold on scheduling new pods to that node and bumped pool desired to +1 so autoscaler can bring up replacement quickly.

maria_cs: heads-up: BluePeak CSM on call (tim@bluepeak) just DMed asking if this is a rolling maintenance or an outage. I'll send a short status update after we have confirmation.

alex_sre: current customer impact: ~8% request failure rate for BluePeak on dedicated routes, degraded throughput but no data leakage. Marking customer impact: degraded service, customer-facing errors. ETA for full mitigation: ~7-12 minutes depending on migration.

ben_platform: migration progress: 9/12 sessions moved; 3 are stuck due to open streaming websockets. Using graceful reattach token to attempt reconnect.

alex_sre: attempt reconnects, but if they don't attach within 30s we'll spin up fallback route to hosted model for those sessions. Use the toggle:
```
rdctl route override --customer bluepeak --route /generate --to hosted-fallback-v2 --duration 30m --reason "node drain"
```

deploy-bot: route override applied for BluePeak /generate -> hosted-fallback-v2. Traffic shift starting now (~20% to hosted fallback, ramp as needed).

maria_cs: emailing BluePeak support inbox now with status. Draft: "We detected hardware failure in your dedicated pool node. We're migrating sessions and routing a portion of traffic to a verified hosted fallback to keep traffic flowing. No customer data was accessed outside your pool. Next update in 15 minutes or when mitigation complete. —Maria, Redwood CS"

lina_infra: drain done, node marked unschedulable. Starting node isolation and image collection for replacement.

ben_platform: all sessions migrated or routed to fallback. Error rate dropping back toward baseline. p95 latency on /generate returning to previous levels for most tenants.

alex_sre: good. I'll begin replacement ticket with infra team to replace GPU on gpu-07 and run burn-in. Creating ticket and tagging hardware team.

alex_sre: created ticket HW-5238, assigned to @lina_infra. Replacement ETA 6 hours to complete procurement + swap; temporary rebalancing remains in effect. We'll keep BluePeak on fallback routing for 30 minutes then re-evaluate.

maria_cs: sent update to customer with current mitigation and timeline.

lina_infra: collecting GPU coredump and attaching to HW ticket. Also ran quick memtest; no RAM errors seen. Suspect GPU silicon fault.

alex_sre: summary for handoff: Incident: gpu-07 hardware failure in dedicated pool bluepeak-prod. Impact: ~8% 503s for BluePeak, mitigated via drain + hosted-fallback routing. Current state: node isolated, replacement ticket created, customer notified. Next steps: hardware replacement (HW-5238), postmortem and RFO. On-call handoff to night SRE at 03:55 UTC — please monitor routing rollback and confirm when node replaced.

ben_platform: will follow up on session rehydration post-replacement; ensure sticky cache checkpoints are reattached to new nodes when they come online.

alex_sre: handing off to @oncall_night now. @oncall_night mentioned? (paging) :bell:

infra-bot: NOTE: severity downgraded to P3 at 03:10 UTC after successful mitigation. Incident will remain open until HW ticket closed.

maria_cs: closing customer comms loop: BluePeak replied "Thanks for quick action. Keep us posted on replacement." I'll schedule a formal post-incident report with them.

alex_sre: final note: create alert rule to detect early ECC escalation on bluepeak-prod (lower threshold) so we catch similar hardware degradation earlier. Adding to action items.

lina_infra: ack. I'll also check inventory for warm spare GPUs to shorten replacement lead time.

ben_platform: marking thread resolved for on-call; keeping incident ticket open for infra.

alex_sre: thanks team. :thumbsup:
